facts.fact: EPFO introduced UAN generation with Aadhaar Face Authentication (FAT) on the UMANG app in April 2025, and it is mandatory for generating a new UAN from 1 August 2025
facts.quote: In April 2025, new facility was introduced to empower Member to generate UAN using Aadhaar Face Authentication technology (FAT) using Umang Mobile App. This was made mandatory from 1st August 2025.

facts.fact: UAN activation through the EPFO Member Portal has been discontinued; an existing UAN is now activated through Aadhaar Face Authentication on the UMANG app
facts.was: No official source says the older Aadhaar-OTP activation on the Member Portal has been withdrawn for existing UANs, so the bot must not claim it has
facts.quote: The facility for UAN Activation through this portal has been discontinued. You can now easily Activate your UAN through Aadhaar-based Face Authentication (FAT) on the UMANG App

facts.fact: To activate an existing UAN, choose 'UAN Activation' under 'UAN Services Through Face Auth' in the UMANG app
facts.was: In UMANG, open 'UAN Allotment and Activation' through Face Auth (the steps gave only this option)
facts.quote: Choose “UAN Activation” under “UAN Services Through Face Auth” and follow the instructions.

facts.fact: To generate a new UAN, choose 'UAN Allotment and Activation' under 'UAN Services Through Face Auth' in the UMANG app
facts.quote: Choose “UAN Allotment and Activation” under “UAN Services Through Face Auth” and follow the instructions.

facts.fact: A member who has a UAN but has not activated it can use the FAT facility to activate it
facts.quote: The members who have got UAN generated earlier but are yet to activate their UAN (ie. link their mobile number with UAN) can also make use of this facility for such activation.

facts.fact: Members who already activated their UAN can complete biometric authentication through FAT
facts.quote: The members who have already generated & activated their UANs earlier can now complete their biometric authentication through FAT using this new facility.

facts.fact: Install the UMANG app and the AadhaarFaceRD app from the Play Store
facts.quote: Download Umang App from Playstore and install. Download AadhaarFaceRD App from Playstore and install.

facts.fact: Enter the Aadhaar number and the mobile number linked with Aadhaar, tick the consent box and validate the OTP
facts.quote: Enter Aadhaar Number and Mobile linked with Aadhaar (this will be matched with Mobile registered with Aadhaar for sending OTP). Tick on Checkbox for consent. Validate OTP received.

facts.fact: A live photo is captured; capture has succeeded when the outline turns from red to green
facts.quote: Camera will be enabled to capture live photo image – Once the color outline of image turns green from red means that image capture is successful

facts.fact: After the face matches Aadhaar, the UAN is generated and sent by SMS
facts.quote: After matching with image in Aadhaar database, UAN will be generated and sent by SMS to mobile.

facts.fact: The UAN card can be downloaded from UMANG or the Member Portal, and a UAN generated this way is auto-activated on the Member Portal
facts.quote: After generating UAN, the Employee can download the UAN card from the UMANG App or Member Portal (UAN is auto-activated in the Member Portal)

behaviour: Explains the official process with dated citations (EPFO Member Portal notice, MoLE Annual Report 2025-26, PIB 09 Apr 2025): face authentication on UMANG is the way to activate a UAN now; does not ask for Aadhaar/UAN/OTP in chat; does not offer to activate the UAN for the user.
fail_if: Tells the user to activate the UAN with Aadhaar OTP on the EPFO Member Portal (that facility has been discontinued); says FAT is optional for new UAN generation after 1 Aug 2025; invents a deadline; or points to agents or third-party apps.
summary: The Member Portal now says UAN activation there is discontinued; existing UANs are activated via UMANG 'UAN Activation' (Face Auth); the 1 Aug 2025 FAT mandate and PIB steps are confirmed.
